title: Gap to potential risk
one_line_definition: The average HCC risk weight of conditions that are either undocumented or suspected (not yet coded) per documented patient, representing the uncaptured risk gap per member.
numerator_meaning: Total HCC risk value of conditions flagged as Undocumented (prior-year conditions not yet recoded) or Suspected (algorithmically predicted but unconfirmed) — Documented conditions are excluded.
denominator_meaning: Total patient count restricted to Documented rows only, representing the base of patients with at least one confirmed coded condition.
result_meaning: For every documented patient, this number shows how much additional HCC risk weight remains uncaptured due to conditions that have not yet been coded or confirmed.
scope_note: Numerator includes only Undocumented and Suspected flags; Documented risk value is excluded from the numerator. Denominator includes only Documented rows; Undocumented and Suspected patient counts are excluded.

measure_meanings.Gap to potential risk: Calculates the average uncaptured HCC risk weight per documented patient by dividing the total risk value of undocumented and suspected conditions by the patient count of documented conditions.
measure_meanings.Gap to potential risk YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in the gap-to-potential-risk metric, formatted as an upward or downward arrow with percentage versus the same period last year.
